editorial.blurb: Chile Toreado is a Chicago favorite beloved for its authentic Mexican cooking, from charbroiled carne en su jugo to standout tlayudas and housemade horchata.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Carne en Su Jugo for the charbroiled steak and flavorful broth — arrive early to catch it at its best, and don't skip the Tlayuda con Carne, which reviewers call one of the best dishes in the city.
